bar._comment: The Windows 11 taskbar: 48px, edge to edge, square, flat. barFill below is what paints it, so the Theme.barFill opacity key is not used.

modules._comment: Windows' arrangement of the shell's building blocks: start, search, Task View and apps centred; tray chevron, status cluster, clock and bell in the corner. Left stays empty as on a stock install. Each hosts the popouts it opens, so nothing else is needed in these lists.

options._comment: The setting Windows 11 itself offers: Taskbar alignment, Left. Right merges through untouched.
options.title: Left-aligned taskbar
options.subtitle: Taskbar alignment: Left

start._comment: 640 wide, as the Windows 11 flyout is before its 2025 enlargement.

theme._comment: Fluent dark on the shell's generic tokens, values from WinUI's Common_themeresources_any.xaml: SolidBackgroundFillColor*, TextFillColor*, ControlFillColor*, SubtleFillColor*, ControlStrokeColor*, AccentFillColorDefault for the default blue (Light2). Alpha colours are #AARRGGBB. Winix UI is Selawik, Microsoft's open metric-compatible Segoe UI, with Fluent icons on the codepoints Icons.qml uses; see system/assets/winix/build-icon-font.py.

lock._comment: The Windows lock screen: no card, clock high and fixed.
